items.title: Unsubscribing n subscribers from ONE cell is O(n²) with a clone each: std::reactive's `release_under` rebuilds the cell's subscriber list per unsubscribe - kolt's Table page (56k cells on one shared cell) still takes 69-102 s to leave after M187
items.status: OPEN - filed 2026-11-04 (lane ui-56's find; M187's remaining lever)
items.discussion: lane ui-56 (Order 56): M187 took the Table shape from 68-73 s to ~200 ms when each cell binds its own source; with all 56k cells binding one shared cell the leave was 99-228 s before and is 69-102 s after, and the profile is `release_under`
items.body: Rec: a subscriber list that removes in O(1) amortized (a swap-remove by index held on the subscription, or a tombstone + compaction as M191's table does) and no clone per entry; measure on the lane's bench (scratchpad/ui-56/bench/drive.mjs: the 56k-cells-on-one-cell shape) and pin a count (`release_under` clones = 0 per unsubscribe). Sizing S-M; the next std::ui/reactive lane.

items.title: A Region's `__dom_run_nodes` result is a JS `Set`, and `__clone` deep-copies Sets: it must never reach a value-seam copy site - today it does not, but nothing pins that
items.discussion: lane ui-56 (Order 56): M187's helpers keep the run's top-level nodes in a Set held by the region; B691 widened what `__clone` copies, so a future seam that reaches the Set would silently deep-copy DOM node references
items.body: Rec: a pin that greps the emitted std for the Set reaching a `__clone` (the copy-elision census can count it: `__dom_run_nodes` results copied = 0), or mark the holder as a non-copy type at the emitter. Sizing XS.
